Introducing Saved Views, available today on all paid plans. If you've ever rebuilt the same filters, sort order, and grouping every time you open a project, this one's for you. Now you can capture any configuration exactly as you set it up and return to it instantly, without redoing the work.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so whether you're tracking sprint progress, flagging overdue tasks, or watching a specific teammate's workload, your setups are always ready when you need them. Views can also be shared with your team, making it easy to align everyone around the same picture of a project, whether that's a status board for a stand-up or a filtered list for a client review.

Saved Views works across every list in your workspace and updates live as tasks change, so shared views stay accurate for everyone who opens them.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
